
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aqi00/p/20342437" title="发布于 2026-06-07 11:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（五）使用AI摘要来压缩上下文消息</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span><span id="cke_bm_504S">前面两篇文章分别介绍了根据消息数量截断历史对话和根据Token长度截断历史对话，可是这两种方式有两个共同的问题：</span>
<p>1、被删去的早期记录可能包含关键信息，直接截断会导致信息丢失。<br>
2、原始的对话记录可能存在重复、冗余、拖沓的文字内容。</p>
<h1>一、为什么要对原始记录做摘要</h1>
<p>要知道，重复、冗余、拖沓的文字内容并不高效，因为它的信息密度很低，很啰嗦，同样的意思使用更少的文字即可表达，完全没必要照搬原始的对话记录。</p>
<p>比如很多小说都有缩写本或者极简本，大幅精简后的文字保持了主要的故事框架，省去了许多次要的细节描写，一样可阅读可理解，整体的故事情节没有发生什么变化。<br>
就历史对话的上下文而言，精简文字内容同样适用，这个精简过程被称作“摘要”，意思是摘取主要信息。对话摘要既保留了原始记录的关键信息，又大幅压缩了原始记录的文字长度，可有效降低下次AI会话的Token消耗。</p>
<p>Python有成熟的第三方库，可以直接对一段中文做自动摘要，无需开发者自己写算法，非常方便。常见的摘要库有snownlp和sumy，分别说明如下。</p>
<h1>二、中文摘要库 snownlp</h1>
<p>snownlp专门做中文的文本处理，内置自动摘要功能，体积小且速度快。在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="9" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20snownlp%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install snownlp</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python摘要测试代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20snownlp%20import%20SnowNLP%5Cn%5Cndef%20summarize_text(text%2C%20limit%3D2)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%3Aparam%20text%3A%20%E5%8E%9F%E6%96%87%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%3Aparam%20limit%3A%20%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E5%87%A0%E6%9D%A1%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%88%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A42%E6%9D%A1%EF%BC%89%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%3Areturn%3A%20%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%E5%8F%A5%E5%AD%90%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20s%20%3D%20SnowNLP(text)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20s.summary(limit)%20%C2%A0%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E5%8F%A5%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95%5Cnif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22__main__%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20text%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%AF%84%E6%B5%8B%E3%80%81%E7%B2%BE%E8%B0%83%E7%AD%89%E5%85%A8%E6%96%B9%E4%BD%8D%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E4%B8%8E%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E5%A4%9A%E7%A7%8D%E4%B8%BB%E6%B5%81%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%B7%E6%9C%89%E7%A8%B3%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%AF%E9%9D%A0%E3%80%81%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%BA%92%E4%BF%A1%E7%9A%84%E7%89%B9%E7%82%B9%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84AI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E9%99%8D%E4%BD%8E%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%88%90%E6%9C%AC%E4%B8%8E%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E9%97%A8%E6%A7%9B%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20summary%20%3D%20summarize_text(text%2C%20limit%3D2)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20s%20in%20summary%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22-%5C%22%2C%20s)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from snownlp import SnowNLP

def summarize_text(text, limit=2):
&nbsp; &nbsp; """
&nbsp; &nbsp; 自动生成摘要
&nbsp; &nbsp; :param text: 原文
&nbsp; &nbsp; :param limit: 提取几条摘要（默认2条）
&nbsp; &nbsp; :return: 摘要句子列表
&nbsp; &nbsp; """
&nbsp; &nbsp; s = SnowNLP(text)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return s.summary(limit) &nbsp;# 自动提取关键句

# 测试
if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; text = """
&nbsp; &nbsp; 火山方舟是火山引擎推出的大模型平台，提供模型训练、推理、评测、精调等全方位功能与服务。
&nbsp; &nbsp; 平台支持多种主流大模型接入，具有稳定可靠、安全互信的特点。
&nbsp; &nbsp; 企业可以通过火山方舟快速构建自己的AI应用，降低开发成本与技术门槛。
&nbsp; &nbsp; """

&nbsp; &nbsp; summary = summarize_text(text, limit=2)
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("自动摘要：")
&nbsp; &nbsp; for s in summary:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("-", s)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%9A%5Cn-%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%5Cn-%20%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84AI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">自动摘要：
- 火山方舟是火山引擎推出的大模型平台
- 企业可以通过火山方舟快速构建自己的AI应用</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见snownlp库把原始的三个长句摘要为两个短句，同时保留了原文的主要意思。</p>
<h1>三、通用摘要库 sumy</h1>
<p>sumy库的功能更强，它支持 TF-IDF、LSA、LexRank、Luhn 等多种摘要算法。在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20sumy%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install sumy</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python摘要测试代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20sumy.parsers.plaintext%20import%20PlaintextParser%5Cnfrom%20sumy.nlp.tokenizers%20import%20Tokenizer%5Cnfrom%20sumy.summarizers.lex_rank%20import%20LexRankSummarizer%5Cn%5Cndef%20sumy_summary(text%2C%20sentences%3D2)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20parser%20%3D%20PlaintextParser.from_string(text%2C%20Tokenizer(%5C%22chinese%5C%22))%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20summarizer%20%3D%20LexRankSummarizer()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20summary%20%3D%20summarizer(parser.document%2C%20sentences)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20%5Bstr(s)%20for%20s%20in%20summary%5D%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95%5Cnif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22__main__%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20text%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%AF%84%E6%B5%8B%E3%80%81%E7%B2%BE%E8%B0%83%E7%AD%89%E5%85%A8%E6%96%B9%E4%BD%8D%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E4%B8%8E%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E5%A4%9A%E7%A7%8D%E4%B8%BB%E6%B5%81%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%B7%E6%9C%89%E7%A8%B3%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%AF%E9%9D%A0%E3%80%81%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%BA%92%E4%BF%A1%E7%9A%84%E7%89%B9%E7%82%B9%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84AI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E9%99%8D%E4%BD%8E%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%88%90%E6%9C%AC%E4%B8%8E%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E9%97%A8%E6%A7%9B%E3%80%82%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20summary%20%3D%20sumy_summary(text%2C%20sentences%3D2)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20s%20in%20summary%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22-%5C%22%2C%20s)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from sumy.parsers.plaintext import PlaintextParser
from sumy.nlp.tokenizers import Tokenizer
from sumy.summarizers.lex_rank import LexRankSummarizer

def sumy_summary(text, sentences=2):
&nbsp; &nbsp; parser = PlaintextParser.from_string(text, Tokenizer("chinese"))
&nbsp; &nbsp; summarizer = LexRankSummarizer()
&nbsp; &nbsp; summary = summarizer(parser.document, sentences)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return [str(s) for s in summary]

# 测试
if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; text = """
&nbsp; &nbsp; 火山方舟是火山引擎推出的大模型平台，提供模型训练、推理、评测、精调等全方位功能与服务。
&nbsp; &nbsp; 平台支持多种主流大模型接入，具有稳定可靠、安全互信的特点。
&nbsp; &nbsp; 企业可以通过火山方舟快速构建自己的AI应用，降低开发成本与技术门槛。
&nbsp; &nbsp; """

&nbsp; &nbsp; summary = sumy_summary(text, sentences=2)
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("自动摘要：")
&nbsp; &nbsp; for s in summary:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("-", s)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%9A%5Cn-%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%AF%84%E6%B5%8B%E3%80%81%E7%B2%BE%E8%B0%83%E7%AD%89%E5%85%A8%E6%96%B9%E4%BD%8D%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E4%B8%8E%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E3%80%82%5Cn-%20%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E5%A4%9A%E7%A7%8D%E4%B8%BB%E6%B5%81%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%B7%E6%9C%89%E7%A8%B3%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%AF%E9%9D%A0%E3%80%81%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%BA%92%E4%BF%A1%E7%9A%84%E7%89%B9%E7%82%B9%E3%80%82%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">自动摘要：
- 火山方舟是火山引擎推出的大模型平台，提供模型训练、推理、评测、精调等全方位功能与服务。
- 平台支持多种主流大模型接入，具有稳定可靠、安全互信的特点。</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见sumy库直接输出原始文字的两个长句，摘要效果不如snownlp库。</p>
<h1>四、使用在线大模型输出摘要</h1>
<p>如果开发者预算充足的话，也可调用国产大模型，在线输出对话内容的摘要文字。<br>
比如登录火山引擎的控制台页面 https://console.volcengine.com/ark ，开通文本模型 Doubao-1-5-lite-32k 的推理服务，会赠送50万Token的免费额度，足够初学者的入门使用。</p>
<p>在编写火山引擎的Python调用代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20--upgrade%20%5C%22volcengine-python-sdk%5Bark%5D%5C%22%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install --upgrade "volcengine-python-sdk[ark]"</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python摘要在线生成代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20volcenginesdkarkruntime%20import%20Ark%5Cn%5Cnclient%20%3D%20Ark(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%AD%A4%E4%B8%BA%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E8%B7%AF%E5%BE%84%EF%BC%8C%E6%82%A8%E5%8F%AF%E6%A0%B9%E6%8D%AE%E4%B8%9A%E5%8A%A1%E6%89%80%E5%9C%A8%E5%9C%B0%E5%9F%9F%E8%BF%9B%E8%A1%8C%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20base_url%3D%5C%22https%3A%2F%2Fark.cn-beijing.volces.com%2Fapi%2Fv3%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%AD%A4%E5%A4%84%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E6%82%A8%E5%9C%A8%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E4%B8%8A%E7%94%B3%E8%AF%B7%E7%9A%84%20API%20KEY%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20api_key%3D%5C%22**********%5C%22%2C%5Cn)%5Cn%5Cntext%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E6%8E%A8%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E3%80%81%E8%AF%84%E6%B5%8B%E3%80%81%E7%B2%BE%E8%B0%83%E7%AD%89%E5%85%A8%E6%96%B9%E4%BD%8D%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E4%B8%8E%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E3%80%82%5Cn%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E5%A4%9A%E7%A7%8D%E4%B8%BB%E6%B5%81%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%B7%E6%9C%89%E7%A8%B3%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%AF%E9%9D%A0%E3%80%81%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E4%BA%92%E4%BF%A1%E7%9A%84%E7%89%B9%E7%82%B9%E3%80%82%5Cn%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E8%87%AA%E5%B7%B1%E7%9A%84AI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E9%99%8D%E4%BD%8E%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%88%90%E6%9C%AC%E4%B8%8E%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E9%97%A8%E6%A7%9B%E3%80%82%5Cn%5C%22%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cncompletion%20%3D%20client.chat.completions.create(%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%23%20%E6%AD%A4%E5%A4%84%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E6%82%A8%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E7%9A%84%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E7%82%B9%20ID%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20model%3D%5C%22doubao-1-5-lite-32k-******%5C%22%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20messages%3D%5B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22role%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22system%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22content%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22%E8%AF%B7%E5%AF%B9%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E7%9A%84%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%E5%81%9A%E7%B2%BE%E7%AE%80%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%8C%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E5%8E%8B%E7%BC%A9%E5%9C%A850%E5%AD%97%E4%BB%A5%E5%86%85%5C%22%7D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7B%5C%22role%5C%22%3A%20%5C%22user%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22content%5C%22%3A%20text%7D%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5D%2C%5Cn)%5Cnprint(%5C%22%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5Cnprint(%5C%22-%5C%22%2C%20completion.choices%5B0%5D.message.content)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from volcenginesdkarkruntime import Ark

client = Ark(
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 此为默认路径，您可根据业务所在地域进行配置
&nbsp; &nbsp; base_url="https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3",
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 此处请输入您在火山引擎上申请的 API KEY
&nbsp; &nbsp; api_key="**********",
)

text = """
火山方舟是火山引擎推出的大模型平台，提供模型训练、推理、评测、精调等全方位功能与服务。
平台支持多种主流大模型接入，具有稳定可靠、安全互信的特点。
企业可以通过火山方舟快速构建自己的AI应用，降低开发成本与技术门槛。
"""

completion = client.chat.completions.create(
&nbsp; &nbsp;# 此处请输入您创建的方舟推理接入点 ID
&nbsp; &nbsp; model="doubao-1-5-lite-32k-******",
&nbsp; &nbsp; messages=[
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"role": "system", "content": "请对用户输入的内容做精简摘要，摘要文字压缩在50字以内"},
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {"role": "user", "content": text},
&nbsp; &nbsp; ],
)
print("自动摘要：")
print("-", completion.choices[0].message.content)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%91%98%E8%A6%81%EF%BC%9A%5Cn-%20%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E6%96%B9%E8%88%9F%E6%98%AF%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E7%9A%84%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%EF%BC%8C%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E5%A4%9A%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%8C%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E5%85%A8%EF%BC%8C%E8%83%BD%E5%8A%A9%E4%BC%81%E4%B8%9A%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BAAI%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E9%99%8D%E6%88%90%E6%9C%AC%E4%B8%8E%E9%97%A8%E6%A7%9B%E3%80%82%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">自动摘要：
- 火山方舟是火山引擎的大模型平台，支持多模型，功能全，能助企业快速构建AI应用，降成本与门槛。</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见在线大模型火山引擎输出了原始文本经过压缩后的摘要文字，并且支持通过提示词设置精简指标，比如摘要长度等等。</p>
